## Per-member checklist

- **#7944 (backend/sizing revision)** — landed in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`: the `mode:` row of the argument table and the 「资源与后端」 paragraph of the dispatch section now carry the 2026-08-12 ruling (S-mechanical + M ⇒ `mode:subagent` with per-dispatch model tiering; `mode:cloud` reserved for L/XL, work that must outlive the PM session, browser/dogfood verification, and build-heavy M by explicit judgment; archive duty narrows to cloud cards). The cloud-vs-subagent trade-off rationale (three fixed taxes vs the one real cost and its mitigations) is recorded on demand in `references/dispatch-runbook.md` under the cloud-lessons section. The mandatory `claude-fable-5` clause for cards editing the pm-dispatch skill is unchanged; the model-resolution facts (env var → per-call param → frontmatter → inherit) were already present in the Model tiering paragraph and stay.
- **#7942 (seat-post read boundary)** — one principle line added to the seat-post section of `SKILL.md` (takeover and patrol read the post body plus only comments newer than the body's last edit — older comments were absorbed by that edit and are archive, not state), with the fuller rule (rationale + how to compare the timestamps) in `references/seat-post-protocol.md`, which loads on demand at takeover time.

## Ratchet accounting (ceiling 686, headroom 0)

The file stays at exactly 686 lines. Additions were offset inside the touched sections:

- Backend paragraph: rewritten 5 → 6 lines; dropped the sentence restating os-dev's parallel-memory discipline (it is normative in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, not here) and the redundant "size is not a sufficient criterion" clause (implied by "S-but-not-mechanical gets M treatment", which stays).
- Cloud-lessons paragraph: 11 → 9 lines; the self-drive clause's expansion ("never end a turn for questions / mid-task status") and the roster mechanism prose were compressed — both remain spelled out in `references/dispatch-runbook.md`.
- Model tiering paragraph: reflowed 11 → 10 lines; dropped 「多面语义」 from the opus examples (subsumed by 「任何带设计判断的卡」).
- Seat-post paragraph: read-boundary principle folded in at +2 lines; the token-tax rationale lives in the reference file only.

No semantic loss beyond the rationalized drops listed above; no issue-ID citations added (id-lint green).
